versions.name: Disabilities Awareness
versions.description: Learn person-first language and disability etiquette, talk with people who live with visible and invisible disabilities, survey buildings for barriers, and take on advocacy by teaching others what you found.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
